title: Intuitive Machines, Inc. Q1 2026 Form 10-Q
excerpt: Q1 revenue was USD 186.7 million, backlog USD 1.055 billion, cash USD 231.6 million, and long-term debt USD 335.8 million.
summary: The unchanged Q1 Form 10-Q remains the latest periodic filing and primary evidence for identity, operating scale, cash burn, backlog, liquidity, debt, dilution and contract risks.
